translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Simón-Pedro ua-ichesur gasad
Degi Jesús mata-dummad-Genesaretgi-naidgi gudii, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad. Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itomalagala na barmesnanai-guarmalad.
Agi Jesús dakalid ur-warbo gakagi nai. E-ibmaladi urgi aides bukwa, saki enukbukwa.
A ur-wargwengi Jesús nakwisad. Dakleargu, a-ur Simón-ur. Jesús Simónga sogded: —Wis be-ur matasik be onoge. Jesús a-urgi sigisad, agi-sii dulemar-bukidar-gakagi-bukwad-odurdakded.
Jesús sunmaked bergusgu, Simónga sogded: —Matasik be-ur be sede, be agi saki mie, ua-gaegar.
Simón, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, anmar oiboalid ua-gananai, degite, anmar ua gwen gassurmalad. Degi-inigwele, be-sogedba an saki miodo.
Ar Simón degi-saki-mismargu, ua-bukidar-gasmalad, a-ular saki achirmakbi-gualid.
Geb degi Simón na e-aimar-ur-baidgi-gunanaidse achasmalad, adi emar-bendakdamalagar. Ese nonimargu, ur-warbo-bela ua enosmargu, ua-enadba ur-dogbi-gualid.
Simón-Pedro ua-bukidar gasa dakdegu, Jesús-abin yokorgi sindigar sigided, ega sogded: —Dummad, angi be bangu, ar an iskudiid-duled.
Ar ua-bukidar-gasadba, Simón, degine, bela-eba-gunanaid dobe itodmalad.

Degine, Simón-e-aimar, Zebedeo-machimala, Santiago, Juan-ebo, dobee itonadmarmogad. Ar Jesúsdi Simónga sogded: —Mer be dobgu, igi bemar ua-gae, abayobi dulemar napneggi gaega emigindi, an be-odurdakmaloed, adi dulemar anba nagumalagar.
Simón, degi, e-aimar gakase ur senonimargu, bela ibmar obesmalad. Degi geb Jesúsba nadmarsunnad e-sapinganga guegar.
Jesús dule-naibe-buna-ya-maleged-nikad nudaksad

Neggwebur-gwensakgi Jesús gudigu, dule-wargwen naibe-buna-ya-maleged-yaisur-nikad ese nonikid, yokorgi sindigar Jesús-asabin signonikid. We-dule Jesúsgi wilenagusad, ega sokalid: —Dummad, an wisi, sunna be an-nudaked, be an-nudakbier.
Geb degi Jesús e-argan ese achadgu, dule-ebusad, geb degi ega sogded: —Nugubi an be-abe. ¡Be nugusun! Degi, dule-boni-nikadi yog nuguar naded.

Jesús dule-nugusadga sogded: —Mer dulemar-baiganga be sogo, an be-nudaksad. Unnila be nae, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledse, be aga oyona be nugusad. Degine, be swilidik guegala, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged be uko, Moisés-igar-mesisadba imakegar, adi amar wisgumalagar be nue nugusad.
Ar degi-inigwele, bela Jesús-nug dungumai gualid, bela wisguarmalad Jesús ibmar-imakdiid. Dulemar-bukidar duurmaknoni-damalad Jesús-itogegar, degine, na uelediid e-nudakegar.
Ar Jesúsdi Bab Dummadse golega nega-dule-sulidganba dulemargi bangud-daed.
Jesús dule-abgan-burgwar-nikad-nudaksad

Ibagwengine, Jesús dulemar-odurdaksigu, Fariseomar, degi, Judio-igar-nue-wisimalad bukwa-gusmogad. Amar bela Galilea-yargi, degi, Judea-yargi, degi, neggweburmar-nanaidgi danimalad. Degine, Jerusalén-neggweburgi danimarbalid. Agi Bab-Dummad-gangued Jesúsba gudigusad, dulemar-gegumalad-nudakegar.
Degi daklealid, machergan e-ai-wargwen abgan-burgwar-nikad e-gabedgi-mai sedanimar. Amar Jesús-siidse neg-yaba e-ai-odobimalad, adi Jesús-asabin mesmalagar, ega nudakegar.
Ar dulemar bukidarsoggu, geg odogedbali, neg-birgi nakwismalad. Uas-egasmargu, agi dule-abgan-burgwaled e-gabedgi-mai dulemar-abargi odesmalad, Jesús-siid-inik.
Jesús a-dulemar egi gwen bensuli dakdegu, dule-gegumaidga sogded: —Dule, be-iskudii-gusad, be nugussun.
Degi escribamar, degi, Fariseomar, na e-gwagegi binsadmalad, sogdemalad: “¿Wede doa-dule, emide Bab Dummadgi dodogu? ¿Unnila Bab Dummadbi sunna dulega iskued elisursi?”
Ar Jesús sunna ulubgi dulemar-binsaed mag daksoggu, dummagan-abin imakdegu, amarga sogded: —¿Ibiga be-ulubgi be degi-binsabukmarsunna? ¿Geg iskued osulo be an-insae?
An dule-bonigwaledga sog-dibe: ‘¡Be-iskunaid an bega osulos!’ Ar igi an sogbarsun-dibe: ‘¡Be nugu, be gwisgu, be nae!’ Degite, ¿igid bur-baisursunna imaklesunna? Suli, ebobela baisursunna imaklesuli.

Degisoggu, ani Dule-Machi, dule-bonigwaled an nudakoed, adi bemar wisguegar, igi dule-bonigwaled sunna an nudake, debayobi we-napneggi dule-gwage-iskunaid sunna an nudakbalid. Jesús dule-abgan-burgwar-nikadga sogdesun: —Ani an bega soged, be gwisgu, be-egi-maid na be sede, be-negse na be nasun.
Degi dule-bonigwaled yog nuguar-gusgu, emar-abargi yog gwisguar imaksad, degi, na e-gabedgi-maid na susgua, e-negse nadsunnad, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummonadap-gusad.
Agi belagwapa geger dakedbimalad, bela Bab-Dummad-nug odummodmalad. Nue dobe itomala, sogdemarsunnad: —Emi-ibagi ibmar-geger-dakleged an daksamalad.
Jesús Levíse gochad, e-sapinga guegar

Jesús dule-nudaksadgi-gwichi nadgu, agi dule-wargwen Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbaed dakalid, Leví-nugad, mani-galeged-neggi sii, mani gasii. Jesús Levíse gote, ega sogded: —Anba be dage, an-sapinga guegar.
Degi Leví gwisgusgu, bela ibmar obes, Jesúsba naded, e-sapinga guegar.
Leví, e-neggi Jesúsga iba-dummad onosad. Agi dulemar-Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamalad bukidar bukwa, degi, baiganmo, e-mesa-naba mas gunbukwa-gusmarmogad.

Agi escribamar, degi, Fariseomar, Jesús-sapinganga sunmakarmalad, sokarmalad: —¿Ibiga dulemar-Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamalad, degi, dulemar-baigan-iskudidimaladba we-Jesús mas gunne, degine, eba gobbali?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dulemar-gegusurmalad ina-duled abesulid, unnila dulemar-gegumaladbi ina-duled abe-damalad.

Deyobi, ar we-napnegse an nonigu, dulemar-nuegan-na-iskudisur-itomaladse golega an nonisulid. An nonikidi, dulemar-iskudii-na-itomaladse golega, adi na e-iskuedga bukib binsamalagar, mer bar iskumalagar.
Bab Dummadse golega mas-gunsuli gudigued

Geb degi dulemar Jesúsga sokarmalad: —Juan-sapingan imbagwenar mas-gunsuli gudidamalad Bab Dummadse golegar. Amba deyob Fariseo-sapingan gudidamarmogad. ¿Ibiga be-sapingandi geg deyob damala? Be-sapingandi mas gundii, degi, gobdii-damalad.
Jesús, abin burbar sogded: —Dulemar ome-nikued-ibagi mas-gullegedse nonikile, dule-ome-nikunaid e-abargi siile, ¿sunna mas-gunsuli bemar-imako be insae? Suli, mas gunmaloe, ar weligwar itomalad.
Ar ibagan nonikoed, dule-ome-nikunaid e-idu seledoed. A-ibagan nonikile, agindi Bab Dummadse golega mas-gunsuli gudigumalodo. Emigindi amba an gudisoggu, an-sapingan geg mas-gunsuli gudigumardo.

Geb degi Jesús ega burbar sunmakdebalid, sogded: “Ar dule mor-matumakegala geg morgo-binid mor-seredgi nasiked. Ar deyob imaksale, unnila mor-binidbi achirmakosulid, deginbali, mor-binid mor-sered-ebo na istar daklebalid.

“Deginbali, inna-gaibid-binid gwen ibmar-uka-bugluga-sobaled-seredgi baliledisulid. Degir, inna-gaibid mudele, buglu-sered esirmako-itole. Degir, binsa inna-gaibid milego-itole, degi, bugluse-bakar binsa miledo-itole.
A-ulale, inna-gaibid-binid buglu-binidgi balileged, adi ebobela nabir igarga guegar.
“Deginbali, dule inna-gaibid gobsale, bar inna-ochigwad sorba gobbisulid, ar ade soged: ‘Inna-gaibirbad bur inna-ochigwadba nuedye.’ Dule-igar deyobmodo, igar-sered geg igar-binid-ebo atoged.”
